_metadata.description: The performance-health-owned Lighthouse runner and the migrated build-time (axis ①) benchmarks.

requirements.title: Lighthouse runner with config thresholds
requirements.description: lighthouse wraps the Lighthouse CLI (its own Chrome, not via BAS) with per-page error/warn thresholds from .vrooli/lighthouse.json (Tier 0, any URL), migrating the config shape from test-genie.

validation.notes: Faked Lighthouse CLI output drives threshold evaluation; per-page error/warn findings are emitted from the config.

requirements.title: Lighthouse silent-skip when CLI absent
requirements.description: When the Lighthouse CLI is absent or no UI URL is available, the runner silently skips with a reason rather than failing.

validation.notes: Missing CLI and missing UI URL both return a skipped result with a reason.

requirements.title: Build-time benchmarks (axis ①)
requirements.description: benchmark times go build ./... and the UI build with thresholds from .vrooli/testing.json performance.budgets (go_build_max_ms, ui_build_max_ms), preserving the test-genie early-exit semantics.

validation.notes: Faked exec/timer asserts threshold breach findings and that early-exit semantics match the migrated config.
